The '''First Army''', also known as '''Azure Hammer Command''' or the '''[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] Sector Army''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] tasked with defending of the [[Imperial Center Oversector|Coruscant sector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==History==
At its zenith, this mighty fleet boasted the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Whelm]]'' along with 57 other [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. Throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] served as the fleet's primary command center. Azure Hammer Command, like all other forces in Sector Zero, was under control by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]].<ref name="CatCW" /> Teshik's command was revoked after his failure to address the threat posed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'', which occured shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> Despite the Grand Admiral's dismissal, Anaxes successfully fended off the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] for numerous years. However, a few months preceding the Thrawn Crisis, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Osted Wermis]] surrendered the command's headquarters Anaxes to the New Republic.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
